summary: This class models the Accessibility flow for HPX Rebranding on Windows platform. It extends HPXRebrandingFlow and provides methods for interacting with Windows UI elements including the Start menu, taskbar, Microsoft Store, and HP application icons. The class focuses on verification and interaction methods for testing HP app accessibility features in Windows environment. All locators are string-based identifiers used with a driver object for UI automation. The class includes methods for dismissing overlays, navigating Windows settings, verifying app presence, and managing app pinning to Start menu and taskbar.
